# interactive-avatar-agent

> A starter for building your own interactive AI avatar agent: a live,
> talking digital avatar that answers questions by voice or text. Minimal
> Node.js backend plus a web page, running on HeyGen LiveAvatar FULL mode
> with a free sandbox demo.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, how it works, run instructions, knowledge base, FAQ

## Optional

- [knowledge.md.example](knowledge.md.example): template for the avatar's knowledge file
